## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Problem / Motivation
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it needed?
> e.g. "I'm always frustrated when I have to..."

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you have in mind. Include any UI/UX ideas, API changes, or flow diagrams if relevant.

## Alternatives Considered
Other approaches you've thought of and why you ruled them out.

## Additional Context
Any mockups, references, or related issues.
